description_zh: 调用CreateDedicatedHostGroup接口创建专属集群
kebab_example: aliyun cddc create-dedicated-host-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --engine MySQL --vpc-id 'vpc-t4n7v5m6icc0a4314****' --client-token 'ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCz*******' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDedicatedHostGroup

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can view https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198326.html to obtain the region ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The database engine type. Valid values:

MySQL
SQL Server
<props="china">
Redis</props>
parameters.help_zh:
数据库引擎类型，取值：

MySQL
SQL Server
<props="china">
Redis</props>
parameters.name: engine

parameters.help_en:
The CPU overcommit ratio of the dedicated cluster.

Valid values: 100% to 300%. Default value: 200%. A value of 200% indicates that the total CPU resources of all instances can be twice the actual CPU resources to maximize resource utilization
parameters.help_zh:
专属集群的CPU超配比。

取值范围：100%~300%，默认取值为200%，代表所有实例的CPU资源之和可以是实际CPU资源的2倍，充分利用资源
parameters.name: cpu_allocation_ratio

parameters.help_en:
The maximum memory usage of each host in the dedicated cluster.

Valid values: 0% to 100%. Default value: 100%
parameters.help_zh:
专属集群中每台主机的内存最大使用率。

取值范围：0%~100%，默认取值为100%
parameters.name: mem_allocation_ratio

parameters.help_en:
The storage overcommit ratio of the dedicated cluster.

Valid values: 100% to 300%. Default value: 200%. A value of 200% indicates that the total storage resources of all instances can be twice the actual storage resources to maximize resource utilization. This parameter does not take effect for SQL Server
parameters.help_zh:
专属集群的空间超配比。

取值范围：100%~300%，默认取值为200%，代表所有实例的空间资源之和可以是实际空间资源的2倍，充分利用资源。该设置对于 SQLServer 无效
parameters.name: disk_allocation_ratio

parameters.help_en:
The resource allocation policy for the dedicated cluster. Valid values:
Evenly (default): balanced allocation. This policy maximizes system stability and preferentially allocates resources from hosts that have no resources allocated or have fewer resources allocated.
Intensively: compact allocation. This policy maximizes resource utilization and preferentially allocates resources from hosts that were created earlier and have more resources allocated
parameters.help_zh:
专属集群资源调度的分配策略。取值：
Evenly（默认）：均衡分配，最大化追求更稳定的系统表现，优先从未分配资源或已分配资源较少的主机中分配资源。
Intensively：紧凑分配，最大化追求更充分的资源利用率，优先从创建时间较早且已分配资源较多的主机中分配资源
parameters.name: allocation_policy

parameters.help_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) to which the dedicated cluster belongs. You can view the VPC ID by clicking VPCs in the left-side navigation pane of the VPC console
parameters.help_zh: 专属集群归属的专有网络ID，可在专有网络控制台左侧单击专有网络查看目标专有网络ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The host replacement policy when a host fails. Valid values:

Auto (default): automatically replaces the host.
Manual: manually replaces the host.

You can select a host replacement policy based on your business requirements only when you create a dedicated cluster that runs the MySQL engine. For other engines, use the default value Auto
parameters.help_zh:
主机故障时系统的处理策略。取值：

Auto（默认）：自动替换主机。
Manual：手动替换主机。

仅创建数据库引擎为MySQL的专属集群时，您可以根据实际需求选择主机故障处理策略。其余引擎均请使用Auto默认值
parameters.name: host_replace_policy

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 客户端生成该参数值，用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。该参数值只能包含ASCII字符，且不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to grant the operating system (OS) permissions on the hosts in the dedicated cluster. Valid values:

0: disabled.
1: enabled.

You can specify whether to grant OS permissions on hosts based on your business requirements only when you create a dedicated cluster that runs the MySQL or SQL Server engine. For other engines, this feature is not supported, and the default value is 0 (disabled). For SQL Server, you must set this parameter to 1 (enabled)
parameters.help_zh:
是否开放专属集群内的主机的OS权限。取值：

0：关闭。
1：开放。

仅创建数据库引擎为MySQL、SQL Server的专属集群时，您可以根据实际需求选择主机开放OS权限。其余引擎暂未提供主机开放OS权限功能，该参数取值默认为关闭。SQLServer 必须要指定开放权限（1）
parameters.name: open_permission

parameters.help_en: The name of the dedicated cluster. The name must be 1 to 64 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character, and can contain digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 专属集群的名称。长度为1~64个字符，以大小字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_）或中划线（-）
parameters.name: dedicated_host_group_desc

DedicatedHostGroupId.description_en: The ID of the created dedicated cluster
